Member.title: Gym Member
Member.description: Represents an enrolled member of DM FITNESS gym.

id.description: Unique identifier for the member document.

fullName.description: Full name of the gym member.

email.description: Contact email address of the member.

address.description: Full residential address of the member.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

membershipType.description: Duration tier of the membership (e.g. 1 Month, 3 Months, or custom duration).

totalFee.description: Total charge amount for this membership tier.

paidAmount.description: Total amount paid toward the membership fee.

balanceDue.description: Remaining unpaid balance owed by the member.

joiningDate.description: Date when member joined in YYYY-MM-DD format.

expiryDate.description: Date when membership expires in YYYY-MM-DD format.

notes.description: Staff or trainer notes for the member.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who added the member.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the member record was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the member record was last updated.

AdminProfile.title: Admin Profile
AdminProfile.description: Represents an authorized gym administrator or staff profile.

role.description: Role level of the staff member.

GymSettings.title: Gym Settings
GymSettings.description: Represents gym configurations such as membership plans and pricing.

updatedBy.description: UID of admin who updated settings.

/members/{memberId}.description: Collection of all gym member records managed by DM FITNESS.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Gym settings including membership plans and custom pricing.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Collection of authorized administrators and staff.
